controller.description: Memoryless law evaluated before each integration step; events use [start,end).
equations: hip_ref=-0.25+0.3*sin(a); knee_ref=0.5+0.2*sin(a-pi/2); ref_velocity is exact derivative.
Scheduled force applied at base center of mass, +world-y, for 0.1s.
